notes: MLAgentBench pilot entry point for the shared researcher-review-v2 protocol; mirrors configs/conversion-v2-two.json.
The MLAgentBench grader is deterministic (native per-task get_score); the judge role is configured for parity but makes no calls in this track.
Altered-budget track: 60 actor calls and the 600-second per-command sandbox limit replace the native 50-step/5-hour run budget; recorded in each episode's environment.

Measured in the sandbox on x86-64 CPU nodes: the pristine cifar10 starter takes 42.7-51.2 s end to end with 4-8 cores, well within the 600-second per-command limit (see docs/adapters/mlagentbench.md).
